summary: Neo-Concept International Group Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 250,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$1.00 per share plus 1,750,000 pre-funded warrants priced at US$0.99 each (exercise price US$0.01), to a single institutional investor under a September 30, 2026 securities purchase agreement. Univest Securities acts as placement agent for a 7.0% cash fee. The last reported sale price was US$14.65 on September 25, 2026, versus the US$1.00 offering price. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch warrant exercise overhang and pricing discount.
